summary: Feely's platform pledges to stand unapologetically with Israel, calling it America's greatest Middle East ally. In October 2023 he affirmed Israel's right to defend itself; in October 2025 he said Hamas must accept Trump's peace deal or face annihilation. His statements frame the conflict solely around Israel's security. The UDP-linked 314 Action Fund spent nearly $1 million against him, but his own words leave no room for Palestinian concern.
